root_cause: The gateway charged lower fees than expected for RuPay debit transactions, indicating a potential under-billing or commercial card level processing mismatch against the modeled benchmark.
diagnosis: Across 9 RuPay debit transactions, the merchant was billed Rs 30.63 to Rs 182.91 versus an expected benchmark fee of Rs 107.21 to Rs 640.17, creating a negative delta exposure of Rs -2,018.31. Note that source_status is illustrative, meaning this comparison relies on a modeled benchmark rather than explicit contracted terms.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway fee configuration will verify whether the lower billed MDR rates are correct per contract or if the gateway is misapplying pricing rules.
